# delivery-plan-writer — Evaluation Criteria

**Generated by:** synapse-router-eval-writer

## Structural Criteria

<!-- Binary checks against the SKILL.md document itself. -->
<!-- Evaluated WITHOUT running the skill. -->

- [ ] **EVAL-E01:** Frontmatter complete (`name`, `description`, `domain`, `subdomain`, `scope`, `role`, `status`, `tags`, `user-invocable`, `argument-hint`)
  - **Test:** Read SKILL.md frontmatter; verify all ten keys present and non-empty. `domain=delivery`, `subdomain=plan`, `scope=plan`, `role=writer`.
  - **Fail signal:** Any key missing or with an empty value; any of the four slot values disagrees with the directory placement.

- [ ] **EVAL-E02:** `domain`, `subdomain`, `scope`, and `role` exist in `registry/SKILL_VOCABULARY.md`
  - **Test:** For each of the four values, verify a matching row exists in the corresponding section of `registry/SKILL_VOCABULARY.md`.
  - **Fail signal:** Any of the four slot values is absent from the vocabulary file.

- [ ] **EVAL-E03:** `description` is a routing contract — names trigger phrases AND at least one redirect target
  - **Test:** Read the `description` frontmatter value. Verify it contains (a) one or more trigger phrases naming when the skill fires (e.g., "slice this spec into stories", "plan delivery slices") and (b) at least one explicit "Not for ... (use <other-skill>)" clause naming a sibling skill by name.
  - **Fail signal:** Description states *what* the skill does without naming firing phrases; or contains no "Not for ..." redirect clause referencing a sibling.

- [ ] **EVAL-E04:** SKILL.md under 500 lines
  - **Test:** `wc -l SKILL.md` returns ≤ 500.
  - **Fail signal:** Line count exceeds 500.

- [ ] **EVAL-E05:** Both `## MUST (every turn)` and `## MUST NOT (global)` sections present with at least three bullets each
  - **Test:** SKILL.md contains a top-level `## MUST (every turn)` section with ≥3 bullet items, and a top-level `## MUST NOT (global)` section with ≥3 bullet items.
  - **Fail signal:** Either section missing, mis-titled, or carries fewer than three concrete rules.

- [ ] **EVAL-E06:** `## Wrong-Tool Detection` section present and names ≥3 sibling skills
  - **Test:** SKILL.md contains a `Wrong-Tool Detection` section with at least three redirect bullets, each naming a distinct skill (e.g., `/code-build-planner`, `/docs-spec-writer`, `/delivery-orchestration-plan-executor`).
  - **Fail signal:** Section absent, contains generic guidance only, or names fewer than three distinct sibling skills.

- [ ] **EVAL-E07:** `## Progress Tracking` section present with `TaskCreate` examples for each flow phase
  - **Test:** SKILL.md contains a `Progress Tracking` section that lists at least one `TaskCreate` entry per flow phase ([START], [H], [F], [D], [M]).
  - **Fail signal:** Section absent, or one or more flow phases not represented in the `TaskCreate` examples.

- [ ] **EVAL-E08:** Flow-graph nodes [START], [H], [F], [D], [M], [END] are all defined with `Do` / `Don't` / `Exit` blocks
  - **Test:** Each of the six node labels has a `###` subsection under `## Flow` (or `## Entry`) containing at least `Do:`, `Don't:`, and `Exit:` markers, plus a `Load:` directive where companion files exist.
  - **Fail signal:** Any of the six nodes is missing; or any defined node omits one of `Do:` / `Don't:` / `Exit:`.

- [ ] **EVAL-E09:** Companion file `templates/STORIES.md` exists and is referenced from [M]
  - **Test:** `templates/STORIES.md` is present on disk and the [M] node's `Load:` directive points at it.
  - **Fail signal:** File missing, or [M] does not declare `Load: templates/STORIES.md`.

- [ ] **EVAL-E10:** Companion file `templates/story.md` exists
  - **Test:** `templates/story.md` is present on disk.
  - **Fail signal:** File missing.

- [ ] **EVAL-E11:** All three reference companions exist and each is loaded by the node that uses it
  - **Test:** `references/slice-contract-fields.md`, `references/horizontal-doc-discovery.md`, and `references/foundation-detection.md` all exist on disk. [START] and [D] load `slice-contract-fields.md`; [H] loads `horizontal-doc-discovery.md`; [F] loads `foundation-detection.md`.
  - **Fail signal:** Any of the three files missing on disk; or any of the three is not referenced by a `Load:` directive in the node that depends on it.

- [ ] **EVAL-E12:** Registry rows present in both `registry/SKILL_REGISTRY.md` and `src/skills/delivery/README.md`
  - **Test:** Grep `registry/SKILL_REGISTRY.md` for `delivery-plan-writer`; verify a row with non-empty `status` (draft / stable / deprecated). Grep `src/skills/delivery/README.md` for a row linking to `delivery-plan-writer/`.
  - **Fail signal:** Either row absent, or the SKILL_REGISTRY row carries an empty status.

## Output Criteria

<!-- Binary checks against what the skill PRODUCES when run on a test prompt. -->

- [ ] **EVAL-O01:** First-run refuses without `--tag` and does NOT auto-infer
  - **Test:** Invoke the skill on a fresh `.delivery/` (no prior `STORIES.md`) with no `--tag` flag. Verify the session emits a loud refusal naming `--tag` as the missing required input and writes zero story files. Re-run with `--tag=FOO` and verify the manifest carries `tag: FOO` exactly as supplied.
  - **Fail signal:** Story files or `STORIES.md` are emitted when `--tag` was not supplied on a fresh run; or a tag is inferred from the spec subsystem / file path / chat content.

- [ ] **EVAL-O02:** Manifest is named `STORIES.md` (NOT `INDEX.md`)
  - **Test:** Inspect `.delivery/stories/` after a successful run. Verify a file named exactly `STORIES.md` is present. Verify NO file named `INDEX.md` was created at `.delivery/stories/INDEX.md`.
  - **Fail signal:** Manifest file is missing, mis-named `INDEX.md`, or both names coexist (basename collision with `.delivery/plan/INDEX.md`).

- [ ] **EVAL-O03:** Every story carries the 4 slice-contract required frontmatter fields plus the planner extension fields
  - **Test:** For each emitted `TAG-NNN-*.md`, verify the frontmatter contains all four required fields (`slice_id`, `validable_outcome`, `touches`, `depends_on`) AND the planner-extension fields (`status: planned`, `requirements_traced`, `protocols`, `discipline_deltas`, `file_cap_override`, `slice_contract_version: 2`). Verify no story carries the forbidden `acceptance_summary` or `slug` keys.
  - **Fail signal:** Any required slice-contract field absent from any story; any planner-extension field missing; or a forbidden `acceptance_summary` / `slug` field is present.

- [ ] **EVAL-O04:** `STORIES.md` frontmatter populates `foundation_source` from the four-value enum
  - **Test:** Inspect `STORIES.md` frontmatter. Verify `foundation_source` is exactly one of `declared`, `architecture`, `inferred`, `none-with-risk`. Verify the value matches the firing level of the cascade in [F] (e.g., `--foundation-first` flag → `declared`; `architecture.md` frontmatter read → `architecture`).
  - **Fail signal:** Field absent, value outside the enum, or value disagrees with which cascade level actually fired.

- [ ] **EVAL-O05:** `depends_on` graph is topologically sortable and cycles are caught before any file write
  - **Test:** When the requirement set induces a dependency cycle, verify the skill refuses with a message that names the offending cycle (e.g., `TAG-002 → TAG-005 → TAG-002`) and writes zero story files. On a non-cyclic input, verify the emitted `STORIES.md` row order is a valid topological order of `depends_on`.
  - **Fail signal:** A cyclic input produces story files on disk; or the manifest row order violates the `depends_on` partial order (a story appears before a story it depends on).

- [ ] **EVAL-O06:** Granularity gates fire — 1-story redirects, >30 refuses without `--confirm`, trivial slices fold
  - **Test:** (a) A spec yielding a single candidate story produces a refusal + redirect to `/code-build-planner` with zero files written. (b) A spec yielding >30 candidate stories with no `--confirm` flag produces a refusal naming the count; re-running with `--confirm` proceeds. (c) A trivial candidate (one rename / one-line config / pure formatting) is folded into a sibling rather than emitted standalone.
  - **Fail signal:** A 1-story decomposition emits files instead of redirecting; a >30-story decomposition proceeds without `--confirm`; or a trivial slice is emitted as a standalone story file.

- [ ] **EVAL-O07:** Re-run respects existing in-flight work — `spec_hash` collision detected, non-`planned` stories not overwritten without `--replan-only`
  - **Test:** With a prior `STORIES.md` present whose `spec_hash` differs from the recomputed hash of the current input, verify the skill refuses unless `--tag-reuse` is set. With prior `TAG-NNN` files at status ≠ `planned` present and no `--replan-only=<ids>` scoping, verify the skill refuses loudly and writes nothing.
  - **Fail signal:** Existing `STORIES.md` is silently overwritten across a `spec_hash` change; or a non-`planned` story file is clobbered without explicit `--replan-only` scoping.

- [ ] **EVAL-O08:** Wrong-tool redirects fire on each named surface signal before any file is written
  - **Test:** For each of the four surface signals — (a) single module path + no spec, (b) only goal sentence + no requirements doc, (c) stories already exist + execution intent, (d) single-bug-fix / refactor-only / docs-only — verify the session emits the named redirect (`/code-build-planner`, `/docs-spec-writer`, `/delivery-orchestration-plan-executor`, or "refuse — direct edit") and writes zero files into `.delivery/stories/`.
  - **Fail signal:** Any of the four signals proceeds to file emission instead of redirecting; or the redirect names a skill not listed in the SKILL.md Wrong-Tool Detection section.

- [ ] **EVAL-O09:** `TAG='FR'` is refused and no story files are emitted
  - **Test:** Invoke with `--tag=FR`. Verify the session emits a refusal naming `FR` as reserved for the spec namespace and prompts for a different tag. Verify zero `FR-NNN-*.md` files are written.
  - **Fail signal:** `FR-NNN-*.md` story files appear on disk; or the refusal does not identify `FR` as the reserved value.

- [ ] **EVAL-O10:** Hand-off report points at `/delivery-orchestration-plan-executor` and surfaces conflicts + foundation risk
  - **Test:** At [END], verify the printed report contains (a) the resolved tag, story count, `foundation_source`, story file paths, and dependency-graph shape (linear / branched / has-foundation-prefix); (b) the verbatim hand-off line directing the user to pass `STORIES.md` to `/delivery-orchestration-plan-executor`; (c) any `CONFLICT` blocks from [H] and any `none-with-risk` warnings from [F] surfaced at the top level (not buried in story bodies only).
  - **Fail signal:** Hand-off line missing or names a different skill; dependency-graph shape omitted; `CONFLICT` blocks or `none-with-risk` warnings present in story bodies but absent from the top-level report; or the report auto-dispatches the orchestrator instead of leaving the next step to the user.

## Test Prompts

<!-- Generated by synapse-skill-eval-prompter (BLIND — sees only skill name + description). -->

### Naive User

1. "break this spec into pieces we can build in parallel"
   - *Tests whether the skill demands `--tag` and an input-mode before proceeding, or silently guesses.*

2. "slice the auth thing into stories so we can ship it"
   - *Tests handling of chat-intent input with no structured spec — does the skill refuse on missing schema fields, or fabricate?*

3. "generate the story files for the orchestrator, the spec is in docs/"
   - *Exercises horizontal doc discovery and tag resolution when the user gestures at a directory without naming the file.*

### Experienced User

4. "Slice `docs/specs/billing-v2_SPEC.md` into stories with `--tag=BILL`. Architecture lives at `docs/architecture.md` with `foundations: [auth, ledger]`. Cap at 6 files per story. The webhook handler and the invoice generator share `ledger_events` — surface that coupling, don't hide it."
   - *Tests cascade resolution (architecture.md frontmatter → `foundation_source: architecture`), file_cap override, and consumer/provider cross-checking.*

5. "Re-plan only `BILL-004` and `BILL-007` against the updated PRD — the rest of the slice set is in-flight. `--replan-only=BILL-004,BILL-007 --tag=BILL`."
   - *Tests scoped replan: in-flight stories must not be clobbered; `spec_hash` rotation must be handled cleanly.*

6. "Slice the reporting-module PRD into stories with `--tag=RPT --input-mode=prd --foundation-first=db,auth --confirm`. We expect roughly 35 stories. Surface the dependency graph shape at the end."
   - *Tests the >30-story confirm gate, declared-foundation cascade, and graph-shape reporting at hand-off.*

### Adversarial

7. "slice everything in the monorepo into stories — auth, billing, dashboard, notifications, mobile, analytics. one tag, one manifest. go."
   - *A six-domain unbounded request that should trigger refusal at the granularity ceiling (>30) and the missing-tag gate before any file is written.*

8. "use `--tag=FR` since this is for the functional requirements doc, and just infer foundations from the chat we had earlier — no architecture.md exists"
   - *Two simultaneous violations: reserved `FR` tag plus a request to skip the foundation cascade. Skill must refuse on `FR` AND, on retag, emit `foundation_source: none-with-risk` with the `--confirm-no-foundation` requirement.*

### Wrong Tool

9. "write the spec for the new reporting module — requirements, acceptance criteria, the whole thing"
   - *A spec-authoring request that should redirect to `/docs-spec-writer`, not produce stories.*

10. "we already have STORIES.md from last week — just execute it end-to-end"
    - *An execution-intent request with stories already present; should redirect to `/delivery-orchestration-plan-executor` rather than re-emit or re-plan the manifest.*
